stories.title: Ypsilanti Township Board Approves Land-Use Moratorium Targeting Electric Infrastructure for Data Centers
stories.dek: Trustees unanimously passed the measure at their Aug. 18 meeting to limit major utility projects, directly affecting a proposed University of Michigan and Los Alamos National Laboratory research data center at Textile and Bridge roads.

stories.title: Bay City neighbors push back on data center plans over power and noise
stories.dek: Residents packed a Bay City planning commission meeting to oppose data centers proposed for their area. They raised alarms about heavy electricity and water demands plus industrial noise that could reach homes. The outcry shows how Michigan towns are starting to question the rapid spread of these facilities.
stories.source_title: Bay City residents voice opposition to data centers at planning commission meeting - MLive.com

stories.title: Mason residents reject data center proposal over grid and water strain
stories.dek: City council heard repeated warnings that the project would push local utilities past capacity and raise rates for households. Speakers questioned whether promised tax revenue would offset the long-term costs to residents. The debate reflects wider worries in mid-Michigan towns about who pays when big tech arrives.
stories.source_title: Residents speak out against data center at Mason City Council meeting - WLNS 6 News

stories.title: St. Joseph County weighs year-long data center moratorium
stories.dek: Officials are considering a pause on new proposals after residents raised alarms over power and water use. A moratorium would give the county time to write rules before projects lock in land and utility contracts. Southwest Michigan communities should care because the decision will influence how quickly data centers spread into rural counties.
stories.source_title: Push for a data center moratorium in St. Joseph County - WSBT

stories.title: Gibraltar sued after rejecting data center project
stories.dek: A developer claims Gibraltar illegally blocked its data center and is taking the city to court. The lawsuit puts local zoning power and potential tax revenue on the line for Wayne County residents. Michigan readers 30 miles away will watch how the case shapes future project fights near Detroit.
stories.source_title: Data center developer sues Gibraltar, claims city illegally blocked project - clickondetroit.com

stories.title: Forsyth Township residents press officials on Sawyer data center
stories.dek: A town hall drew locals worried about noise, power use and water strain from a proposed data center in the Sawyer area. Marquette County taxpayers could face higher utility bills if the project moves forward. The meeting shows how Upper Peninsula communities are pushing back on big tech builds.
stories.source_title: Forsyth Township town hall addresses data center concerns in Sawyer area - myupnow.com

stories.title: Ypsilanti halts big utility builds over U-M supercomputer plans
stories.dek: Ypsilanti Township approved a moratorium on large utility structures that could support the University of Michigan's expanding supercomputing needs. The pause gives local officials time to assess impacts on power demand and land use in the township. Washtenaw County residents could see delayed infrastructure projects tied to heavy electricity users.
stories.source_title: Ypsilanti Township approves moratorium on large utility structures amid U of M supercomputing plans - WXYZ 7 News Detroit

stories.title: Michigan Regulators Release Energy Cost Recommendations as Advocates Push for Stronger Data Center Protections
stories.dek: The Michigan Public Service Commission unveiled steps to lower energy costs, prompting calls for swift action on data center guardrails to protect ratepayers and the grid.

stories.title: Detroit-area residents describe daily life next to large data centers
stories.dek: The Detroit Free Press reports on noise, traffic, and electricity costs felt by people living beside Michigan data centers. Nearby homes face constant equipment hum and higher utility bills as more facilities come online. The story shows concrete effects for anyone within a short drive of proposed sites.
stories.source_title: What it looks like to live next to a sprawling data center - Detroit Free Press

stories.title: Resident demands rule changes after recall bid over data center vote fails
stories.dek: A Michigan voter tried to oust local officials who backed a data center project and lost. She is now pushing broader changes to how such votes are handled. Readers across the state see how one township fight could shape future projects and accountability.
stories.source_title: Her effort to recall officials over data center vote was rejected. Now she’s calling for reform. - MLive.com

stories.title: Golf course next to Oracle's Saline site sold to data center firm
stories.dek: Related Digital bought Rustic Glen to expand near the $43B Oracle campus. The purchase adds pressure on Washtenaw roads, power lines and water use. Nearby homeowners could see construction lasting years.
stories.source_title: Data center developer buys golf course next to massive Oracle construction site - Crain's Detroit

national.title: Data centers advance rapidly as regulators scramble for rules
national.dek: Across the U.S., officials race to impose guardrails on power-hungry facilities while communities push back on incentives and impacts.
